elements.name: init
elements.brief: Opens the default audio device and creates the context every other call
elements.description:
Opens the default audio device and creates the context every other call
works through. Call it once, before creating sources.

elements.name: get_info
elements.brief: Reads which OpenAL implementation is running.
elements.description: Reads which OpenAL implementation is running.

elements.name: set_distance_model
elements.brief: Sets the model every source's attenuation with distance is calculated by.
elements.description: Sets the model every source's attenuation with distance is calculated by.

parameters.name: distance_model
parameters.doc: The attenuation model; a name outside the seven is ignored.

elements.name: new_source
elements.brief: Creates a sound source and loads a WAV file into it. Only a mono sound is
elements.description:
Creates a sound source and loads a WAV file into it. Only a mono sound is
positioned; a stereo one plays as if it were at the listener.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.doc: The WAV file's data, as `resource.load` returns it.

returnvalues.doc: The source, or `undefined` when the data cannot be loaded as a WAV file.

elements.name: remove_source
elements.brief: Destroys a source and frees its sound. Reading or writing the source's
elements.description:
Destroys a source and frees its sound. Reading or writing the source's
properties afterwards is an error.

parameters.name: source
parameters.doc:
The source to destroy; `undefined` is ignored, so a failed
{@link new_source} result can be passed as is.

elements.name: doppler_factor
elements.brief: Scales the Doppler effect; a higher value makes it more noticeable. A value that is not positive is ignored.
elements.description: Scales the Doppler effect; a higher value makes it more noticeable. A value that is not positive is ignored.

elements.name: speed_of_sound
elements.brief: The speed of sound the Doppler effect is calculated with. A value that is not positive is ignored.
elements.description: The speed of sound the Doppler effect is calculated with. A value that is not positive is ignored.

elements.name: listener
elements.brief: The point every sound is heard from.
elements.description: The point every sound is heard from.

properties.name: renderer
properties.brief: The renderer the implementation plays through.
properties.description: The renderer the implementation plays through.

properties.name: extensions
properties.brief: The OpenAL extensions the implementation supports, separated by spaces.
properties.description: The OpenAL extensions the implementation supports, separated by spaces.

functions.name: rewind
functions.brief: Moves playback back to the start of the sound.
functions.description: Moves playback back to the start of the sound.

properties.name: dx
properties.brief: X component of the direction the sound cone points in.
properties.description: X component of the direction the sound cone points in.

properties.name: max_distance
properties.brief: The distance past which the source no longer attenuates under a clamped distance model, `1000` by default.
properties.description: The distance past which the source no longer attenuates under a clamped distance model, `1000` by default.

properties.name: rolloff_factor
properties.brief: How fast the source attenuates with distance.
properties.description: How fast the source attenuates with distance.

properties.name: reference_distance
properties.brief: The distance at which the volume drops by half before `rolloff_factor` and `max_distance` apply, `50` by default.
properties.description: The distance at which the volume drops by half before `rolloff_factor` and `max_distance` apply, `50` by default.

properties.name: min_gain
properties.brief: The lowest gain the source attenuates to.
properties.description: The lowest gain the source attenuates to.

properties.name: max_gain
properties.brief: The highest gain the source plays at.
properties.description: The highest gain the source plays at.

properties.name: cone_outer_gain
properties.brief: The gain outside the sound cone.
properties.description: The gain outside the sound cone.

properties.name: cone_inner_angle
properties.brief: Inner angle of the sound cone, in degrees.
properties.description: Inner angle of the sound cone, in degrees.

properties.name: cone_outer_angle
properties.brief: Outer angle of the sound cone, in degrees.
properties.description: Outer angle of the sound cone, in degrees.

properties.name: time
properties.brief: Playback position in seconds; setting it seeks.
properties.description: Playback position in seconds; setting it seeks.

properties.name: is_looping
properties.brief: Whether the sound repeats indefinitely, `false` by default.
properties.description: Whether the sound repeats indefinitely, `false` by default.

properties.name: is_relative
properties.brief: Whether the position is relative to the listener, `false` by default.
properties.description: Whether the position is relative to the listener, `false` by default.

properties.name: orientation_at_x
properties.brief: X component of the "at" vector, the direction the listener faces.
properties.description: X component of the "at" vector, the direction the listener faces.
